answer: A haven from sybils needs one concrete check: registration binds each identity to a hardware-attested key slot, and a second key on the same secure element costs 40 credits per epoch in attestation fees. A farm of 600 sybils therefore needs 600 physical elements, a floor of 24,000 credits per epoch against a reward cap of 120 per identity. An honest agent is a violet-stamped oasis: it attests one key once, pays nothing more, and keeps its full reward.
